subject: [hw] DEC04: only blocker left is landing include/redwood_vcodec.h rev 3; validated twice, V40 diff cannot compile in-tree without it
body:
Status: DEC04 is DONE host-side (N2TEST DEC04 PASS 1917/1917, V40 1440/1440 on the patched /tmp copy) and my production diff for hw-v40 is posted and applies cleanly to the current vcu/n2vcu.c. The one remaining dependency is the frozen header: include/redwood_vcodec.h is still rev 2, so vcu/n2vcu.c cannot reference RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL in the tree and hw-v40 cannot apply my diff there.

The exact rev-3 text is DEC07s `kern/test_dec07/patches/redwood_vcodec-rev3.patch` (rev b with the larb4 comment). I validated my package against that exact patch (not only against my /tmp staging):
  DEC04 tests ... win 12 count 13; SUMMARY 159 159; N2TEST V40 PASS 1440/1440.
K02 has already landed the kernel side (rev 7) and DEC07 the fake text, so the header is the last piece; DEC07 asked hw-lead to land it, and if hw-lead is away, root or opus-kern can apply that one patch. It cannot disturb the q10jx encode path: no ABI struct/ioctl changes, RWVC_ABI_VERSION stays 1, existing window indices unchanged; the kernel patch handles both revisions.

I will re-run the full acceptance and post the tree sha the moment it is in. No phone, nothing published.
